newsitem.title: INDONESIA: No Busang comment from Indonesian mines ministry.
newsitem.headline: No Busang comment from Indonesian mines ministry.

text.p: The Indonesian Mines and Energy Ministry had not yet seen a report which said there was no economic gold deposit at the Busang property and had no immediate comment, a ministry official said on Monday.
He said Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana had been in a meeting on economic development with other economic ministers through the morning.
"We have not yet got the report, so at this time we cannot comment," the ministry official said.

An interim report by Canadian consulting firm Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd, released in Canada late on Sunday, said there appeared to be no commercially viable gold at the Busang property in East Kalimantan province and spoke of massive fraud.
The small Canadian mining firm Bre-X Minerals Ltd had earlier estimated gold reserves of nearly 71 million ounces at Busang, which would have made it the find of the century.
